name: Camp Kaleidoscope
description_short: A child-centered summer day camp for ages 6-12 at AS220 Community Studios in Providence, RI, running 8:30 am to 3:30 pm. Campers pick from optional staff-led activities such as open shop, electronics, cardboard crafts, art, programming and science projects, or work on their own projects and design their own camp day.
